jobs.title: Desarrollador/a .NET Senior (Híbrido)
jobs.description:
En BETWEEN
te ofrecemos las oportunidades que necesitas para alcanzar tus objetivos profesionales. Si quieres desarrollar tus capacidades en IT e Ingeniería ¡este es tu próximo destino!

Damos soporte en una gran variedad de áreas como Firmware, Software, BI, Diseño, Project Management y muchas más. Además, desarrollamos soluciones tecnológicas a medida desde nuestros BETWEEN Labs.

Estamos buscando un/a desarrollador/a .NET Senior
para ampliar uno de nuestros equipos en Barcelona.

Funciones

Diseñar, desarrollar, probar e implementar aplicaciones y servicios utilizando el stack tecnológico .NET.
Colaborar con el equipo de la arquitectura de software, asegurando la escalabilidad, mantenibilidad y rendimiento de las soluciones.
Trabajar con bases de datos relacionales (SQL) y NoSQL,
Integrar sistemas y servicios, utilizando tecnologías de mensajería como Kafka.
Aplicar principios de DevSecOps para garantizar la seguridad y la calidad del código en todas las fases del desarrollo.

Valorable

Explorar y aplicar conceptos de Inteligencia Artificial (IA) y Machine Learning (ML) para mejorar las funcionalidades y la eficiencia de las aplicaciones.
Haber participado en arquitectura de soluciones.

Beneficios

Seguro médico con Alan.
Oportunidades de formación continua: Idiomas, Certificaciones, Bootcamps y mucho más.
Participación en multitud de eventos: BETWEEN Night, Torneo de Padel, Black Mamba Race y mucho más.
Retribución flexible (restaurante, transporte, guardería).
Incentivos por validar o recomendar talento.
Oportunidad de trabajar en proyectos innovadores y desafiantes.
Entorno de trabajo dinámico y colaborativo en un modelo híbrido.
Desarrollo profesional y crecimiento dentro de la compañía.
Participación en la definición de la estrategia técnica y arquitectónica.
Cultura empresarial que fomenta la innovación y el aprendizaje continuo.

Si eres un profesional con una sólida experiencia en desarrollo .NET,
pasión por la tecnología y buscas un entorno donde puedas crecer y aportar valor, ¡esta es tu oportunidad!

jobs.title: Desarrollador/a .NET
jobs.description:
¿Quiénes somos?

Inforges es la consultora de referencia en la Región de Murcia, con más de 15 empresas que forman parte del grupo, especializada en servicios de consultoría con tecnologías de referencia a nivel internacional. Contamos con una sólida trayectoria de 47 años en el mercado, sumando más de 400 empleados a nuestra plantilla, en todo el territorio nacional.

Somos partner principal de 5 de los ERP más importantes del mercado, SAP Business One , Ekon, Odoo, Frutec y SAP S4. Actualmente buscamos incorporar un/a Desarrollador/a .NET Junior
para unirse a nuestro equipo.

⚙ ¿Cuál será tu misión?

Colaborar en el desarrollo y evolución de aplicaciones y servicios .NET que permitan conectar sistemas, automatizar procesos y garantizar la correcta trazabilidad de la información en entornos empresariales.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones principales?

Desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones y servicios utilizando C# y .NET Core
.

Diseñar y consumir APIs REST
para la integración entre sistemas.

Trabajar con bases de datos SQL para consultas, análisis y validación de información.

Analizar incidencias técnicas e identificar el origen de errores entre diferentes aplicaciones.

Colaborar con equipos funcionales y técnicos en la definición e implementación de soluciones.

Documentar desarrollos, procesos e integraciones.

Utilizar herramientas de automatización e Inteligencia Artificial para mejorar la productividad y calidad del desarrollo.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Modalidad de trabajo 100% en remoto

Aprendizaje continuo en entornos Microsoft y proyectos empresariales.

Participación en proyectos de transformación digital e integración de sistemas.

Trabajo junto a profesionales con amplia experiencia técnica.

Posibilidad de crecimiento dentro de la compañía.

¿Qué buscamos en ti?

Formación en Desarrollo de Aplicaciones, Ingeniería Informática o similar.

Entre 1 y 3 años de experiencia
en desarrollo con C# y .NET Core
.

Experiencia desarrollando o consumiendo APIs REST
.

Conocimientos de SQL
y bases de datos relacionales.

Capacidad analítica y orientación a la resolución de problemas.

Ganas de aprender y desarrollarte profesionalmente.

⭐ Valorable

Conocimientos de SAP o entornos ERP.

Experiencia en integración de sistemas.

No hace falta experiencia previa en EDI, pero sí conocer los conceptos.

Uso de herramientas de IA aplicadas al desarrollo.

Si te apasiona el desarrollo .NET, quieres participar en proyectos tecnológicos de impacto y seguir creciendo profesionalmente en una compañía líder en transformación digital, ¡queremos conocerte!

jobs.title: C# .NET Developer | Business Delivery Solutions
Senior Full-Stack Engineer - DBO
jobs.description:
Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4.com.

What You Will Do. A Glimpse Into Your Role

As a .NET & Angular Developer, you will contribute to the design, development, and support of modern in‑house DBO applications. You will play a key role in delivering high‑quality, secure, and scalable technology solutions that power Global Blue’s Tax‑Free Shopping products.

Working closely with your Development Lead and collaborating daily with Product, QA, UX, and DevOps, you will be part of a mature agile environment where engineering excellence, ownership, and collaboration shape the team’s success.

You will develop a deep understanding of our systems and be involved in every stage of the Software Development Lifecycle—from design through deployment and ongoing operations.

Every action has an impact. You will make a difference here if you:

Design and evolve scalable, maintainable services and web applications with clarity, simplicity, and long‑term sustainability in mind.
Apply Clean Architecture and clean coding practices daily; uphold SOLID, KISS, and YAGNI principles in both your work and peer reviews.
Take full ownership of quality: define testing strategies, build meaningful automated tests, and ensure reliable, regression‑resistant deliveries.
Champion secure‑by‑design approaches; mitigate vulnerabilities through thoughtful design, threat awareness, and defensive coding.
Take operational ownership of services: enable observability, build dashboards and alerts, and participate in incident response and post‑mortems.
Collaborate effectively with Product, QA, UX, and DevOps to refine requirements, identify risks, and communicate technical trade‑offs clearly.
Model and manage data using relational design best practices to ensure correctness, performance, and scalability.
Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering processes, developer experience, and documentation.
Mentor and coach teammates; share knowledge, pair program, and elevate the team’s engineering standards.
Use AI‑assisted engineering responsibly (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to improve quality and productivity while maintaining human oversight.

Key competencies to empower your journey. You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

Technical Skills

.NET 8–10 (C#): strong experience building modern web APIs, background services, and expertise with ASP.NET Core and Entity Framework.
Angular 19+ & TypeScript: experience with component architecture, state management (NGRX/RxJS), accessibility, and performance‑focused UI design.
Relational Databases (MSSQL): strong knowledge of schema design, indexing, query tuning, execution plans, locking, and troubleshooting.
RabbitMQ: understanding of durable messaging, retries/DLQs, idempotency, and resilient consumer patterns.
Containers & Orchestration: experience with Docker (multi‑stage builds, hardened images) and Kubernetes deployments.
CI/CD & Developer Experience: automated build/test pipelines, code review hygiene, git branching, and quality gates.
Observability: structured logging, metrics, tracing (OpenTelemetry or similar), and building meaningful dashboards and alerts.
Security: OWASP Top 10 and ASVS mindset, secure coding, OIDC/OAuth2, and awareness of PCI‑DSS requirements.
AI‑assisted Engineering: proficient using GitHub Copilot or IDE‑based agents with strong validation skills.
Engineering Excellence: Clean Architecture, Clean Code, SOLID, YAGNI, KISS, and comprehensive automated testing across unit, integration, and contract levels.

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities.
Clear verbal and written communication skills in English.
Ability to explain complex technical topics to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
Collaborative, proactive team player in international and multi‑disciplinary environments.

Preferable skills and competencies

Experience with Nx monorepos and micro‑frontend architectures in large Angular ecosystems.
Knowledge of Redis and distributed caching patterns.
Experience with performance tuning across backend, database, and frontend layers.
Familiarity with Azure services (e.g., ACR, managed databases, monitoring).
Experience defining and implementing SLOs/SLIs with actionable alerting.
Background in payments/financial services or compliance‑driven environments.
Experience collaborating across multi‑team international setups.

Qualifications And Education Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field; or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of professional software development, with strong experience in backend or full‑stack engineering.
Proven experience operating services in production environments.
Hands‑on experience within agile delivery frameworks.
Strong English skills (written and spoken) in technical work environments.

Together, we go further

Great Work Happens When Talented People Come Together In An Inspiring, Collaborative, And Supportive Environment. Here’s What You Can Expect

A role in a fast‑growing, international company.
Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning.
A multicultural, global workplace with inspiring colleagues.
A dynamic, innovative engineering culture.
A range of employee benefits, including: Employee referral program, Team‑building activities and events, Annual celebrations and more.

We embrace Agile ways of working, encourage internal mobility, and prioritize work‑life balance. Guided by our 5 Ways of Working, we value collaboration, client focus, innovation, and shared success.

Feels like you? Explore further!

Let’s write the future together: apply now!

jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Sales Engineering
jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Checkout.com is seeking an experienced Sales Engineer to join our team here in Dubai! The successful candidate will be responsible for providing technical leadership and guidance to our clients in the MENA region, throughout the entire sales lifecycle. As a Sales Engineer, you are responsible for technical ownership of client relationships from initial contact in the sales cycle throughout the solutioning, integration, and go-live stages of the customer journey. The ability to solve business and technical requirements through the application of Checkout.com products and solutions is core to the success of the position. Along the way, you'll collaborate closely with various in-house talents across Technology and Business to position our capabilities, products, services and solutions effectively with prospects.

What You Will Do

Upfront qualifications of merchants technical needs
Work with Sales to provide product/business/tech knowledge in support of pre-sales activities
Prepare and lead technical/commercial workshops
Provide inputs for proposals and large and complex RFP and RFI responses
Improve solution design, documentation and realisation of custom merchant solutions
Improve communication with merchants on a technical level during the sales process
Translate product, business and technical requirements into solutions
Being constantly up to date with industry standards in order to offer the best bespoke solutions to our merchantsConduct thorough upfront qualification of merchant needs and technical infrastructure.
Act as the primary technical subject matter expert, supporting the Sales team through all pre-sales phases.
Design, prepare, and lead technical and commercial workshops for prospective merchants.
Provide critical technical and solution design inputs for high-value proposals and RFP/RFI responses.
Drive the improvement of solution design quality and documentation for complex solutions.
Significantly improve the quality and clarity of technical communication with merchants.
Expertly translate requirements into concrete, viable, and efficient solution designs.
Maintain deep industry expertise to design best-in-class, bespoke solutions.

Qualifications

8+ years experience as a Sales Engineer / Solutions Architect or Pre-Sales Consultant
Experience working in a technical client-facing role
Familiar with API based integration methods, associated best practices, and related tools/frameworks
Experience with at least one common front-end (pure JavaScript, React, Angular, etc) and back-end (Java, .NET, Python, Node, etc) technology
Commercially-minded
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
Highly organized and able to prioritize shifting workloads and responsibilities effectively
Able to thrive in a fast-paced environment
Ability to translate technical jargon into business speak
Previous exposure to RFI/RFP
Very well-versed in payments; should understand the technicalities inside and out (ideally this should be a bonus requirement not a needed one)
In depth payments industry exposure with an understanding of the related rules and regulations and payments schemes

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at
Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram
